parameters.documentation: Live price feed. Subscribe to a symbol (e.g. BTC) to receive a PriceTick ~once per second while the feed is running. Resumable: reconnect within 60s and the server replays the missed ticks by eventId. The feed is anonymous (subscribe as anyone); the admin starts/stops it via Portfolio.StartFeed/StopFeed.
